# openvicloud_vm (Resource)

A virtual machine of the tenant. Only name changes in place; any other change replaces the VM. Power is not managed here: stop and start a VM with the CLI or the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openvicloud_templates" "here" {
  cluster_id = "singapore01"
}

resource "openvicloud_ssh_key" "me" {
  name       = "me"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}

resource "openvicloud_vm" "web" {
  name           = "web-1"
  cluster_id     = "singapore01"
  network_id     = openvicloud_network.web.id
  template_id    = data.openvicloud_templates.here.templates[0].id
  vm_offering_id = "s"
  ssh_key_ids    = [openvicloud_ssh_key.me.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster of the VM; the same as its network's.
- `name` (String) Up to 64 letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit; unique in the tenant.
- `network_id` (String)
- `template_id` (String) Operating system (data source openvicloud_templates).
- `vm_offering_id` (String) Size of the VM (data source openvicloud_vm_offerings).

### Optional

- `disk_size_gb` (Number) Root disk size; the template's own size when not set (shown as 0).
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of String) SSH keys (openvicloud_ssh_key) that may log in as user ubuntu.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) cloud-init user data, up to 32768 bytes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) Private IPv4 address.
- `public_ipv6_address` (String) Public IPv6 address, when the network has a public /64.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import openvicloud_vm.web <vm id>
```
